name: Augustino Orlando
bioAdditions: Agostino Antonio was baptized on 30 August 1748, son of Giuseppe Orlando and Domenica Berardelli (S1). He married Maria Mollame, daughter of Domenico, on 6 May 1782 (S2). His parents and his wife are new to the tree.
